definition_en: to forbid, especially by law or authority; an official prohibition
core_image: 领主敲下公告：此事从此不许做
scene: 城门口贴出告示，禁止在河道里排污。The city banned dumping into the river.
sceneCN: 这里 ban 是「禁止」（第 1 个义项：以权力明令不许）；句意：该市禁止向河中排污。

derivatives.zh: 旗帜；横幅（与 ban 同源词线）
结婚预告（同根古义留存）

senses.title: To forbid by authority
senses.definition: to forbid something by official order
senses.example: The council banned cars from the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 市议会禁止汽车进入老城。
senses.why: The Germanic root meant to command under penalty: a command you dare not refuse.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根本义「以罚相令」：不敢违抗的命令。

senses.title: An official prohibition
senses.example: A ban on plastic bags takes effect next month.
senses.why: The command becomes the written notice itself.

senses.title: To ostracize or exclude
senses.definition: to shut someone out of a community or activity
senses.definitionCN: 把某人逐出社群或活动
senses.example: He was banned from the club for a year.
senses.why: The old summon could also cut a person off from the community's peace.
senses.whyCN: 古老的「召集令」也可把人逐出共同体庇护。

senses.title: To curse or condemn
senses.definition: to pronounce a curse against; to condemn publicly
senses.example: The heretic was ban(ned) by the church courts.
senses.exampleCN: 异端被教会法庭诅咒定罪。
senses.why: The lord's word carried penalty; the church's word carried anathema.
senses.whyCN: 领主之言附带罚则；教会之言附带咒逐。

senses.title: The ban: a call to arms
senses.definition: a historic summons calling vassals to military service
senses.definitionCN: 历史上召集封臣服役的令书
senses.example: The king raised the ban and the levies marched.
senses.exampleCN: 国王发出征召令，队伍开拔。
senses.why: Before prohibition, ban was a summons: the same word that calls out also keeps out.
senses.whyCN: 在「禁止」之前，ban 是召集令：同一词既召之也拒之。

senses.title: Banns of marriage
senses.definition: public announcement of an intended marriage in church
senses.definitionCN: 教会对拟结婚事的公开宣告
senses.example: The banns were read three Sundays running.
senses.exampleCN: 结婚预告连续三个主日宣读。
senses.why: The public summons survives in the wedding notice.
senses.whyCN: 公开召集令在婚礼预告中留存。

senses.title: Figurative everyday bans
senses.definition: an informal rule forbidding something within a group
senses.definitionCN: 群体内部不成文的禁规
senses.example: There's a family ban on phones at dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 家里规定吃饭时禁用手机。
senses.why: Any household authority issues its small summonses.
senses.whyCN: 家中的权威同样颁布小型禁令。

senses.title: Banal connection
senses.definition: the root of banal, belonging to everyone's use under the lord's ban
senses.definitionCN: banal 的词根：在领主禁令之下人人共用的
senses.example: Ban and banal share one feudal story.
senses.exampleCN: ban 与 banal 同属一段封建叙事。
senses.why: What is under the ban is common to all tenants.
senses.whyCN: 处于禁令之下的设施归全体佃户共用。

intro.en: Ban comes from a Germanic verb bannan, to command under penalty; it passed through Frankish into Old French ban and returned to English both directly and via French legal use.
intro.cn: ban 出自日耳曼动词 bannan「以罚相令」，经法兰克语进入古法语 ban，再直接或经法语法律用语回到英语。

items.en: The verb meant to order under threat of penalty.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼动词意为「以罚相令」。

items.en: German kept bannen, to command or conjure.
items.cn: 高地德语保留 bannen「命令、咒禁」。

items.en: Frankish ban, a lord's proclamation, became Old French ban: summons, jurisdiction, fine.
items.cn: 法兰克语 ban「领主公告」成为古法语 ban：召集、辖权、罚金。

items.en: English took the word twice: directly as ban and through French legal terms.
items.cn: 英语两次借入：直接借 ban，又经法语法律用语。

items.en: The prohibition sense, strengthened in the twentieth century, now leads the word.
items.cn: 二十世纪「禁止」义得到强化，成为主导义项。

note.en: Group one holds the summons family and look-alikes; group two holds the prohibition field.
note.cn: 第一组收「召集令」词族与形近词；第二组收「禁止」义场。

entries.definition: to send away by decree; ban plus a French verb ending.
entries.definitionCN: 放逐；ban 加法语动词尾。

entries.definition: worn out from common use; the feudal fee-oven line.
entries.definitionCN: 陈腐的；出自封建公共设施义。

entries.definition: a printed cloth from Hindi; only the spelling misleads.
entries.definitionCN: 印花方巾；出自印地语，词源无关。

entries.definition: to order someone not to do something.

normalIntro.en: ban was the lord's word: his command and his penalty in one syllable.
normalIntro.cn: ban 是领主之词：一个音节里同时装着命令与罚则。

normal.en: Root: Germanic bannan, command under penalty.
normal.cn: 词根：日耳曼 bannan「以罚相令」。

normal.en: Phrase: lift the ban, set aside the order.
normal.cn: 短语：lift the ban，解除禁令。

abstract.en: Hear the gavel: one syllable, and the door closes.
abstract.cn: 听法槌一响：一个音节，门便关上。

abstract.en: Ban is the fence made of sound.
abstract.cn: ban 是用声音筑起的栅栏。

abstract.en: Picture the notice nailed to the gate.
abstract.cn: 想象钉在城门上的告示。

examples.en: The league banned him for betting on games.
examples.cn: 联盟因他赌球而将其禁赛。

examples.en: A night-time ban on flights eased the noise.
examples.cn: 夜间航班禁令缓解了噪音。

examples.en: The banns will be read this Sunday.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「绊」——一道命令把你绊在门外，进不去了

root: 出自原始日耳曼语 *bannan「以罚相令」，经法兰克语入古法语 ban「领主召集令、辖权与罚金」；英语兼收日耳曼与法语两条词线。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from command to prohibition: the lord's summons, the legal ban, exclusion, curse, levy, banns, household rules, and the banal kinship.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项由命令走向禁止：领主召集、法定禁令、逐出、咒逐、征召、结婚预告、家规，以及与 banal 的亲缘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the lord's word that both calls out and shuts out.
core.cn: 核心意象：既召集又拒斥的领主之词。

branches.en: Command under penalty, whether fine or curse.
branches.cn: 附罚则的命令，罚金或咒逐皆然。

branches.en: The order written down becomes prohibition.
The community's peace can exclude as well as include.
branches.cn: 共同体庇护既能容纳也能逐出。

branches.en: The summons survives in levies and wedding banns.
branches.cn: 召集令存于征召与结婚预告。

branches.en: Under the ban, all things are common: banal.

intro.en: The ban family spreads through Germanic and French legal words; every branch keeps the commanding voice.
intro.cn: ban 词族遍布日耳曼与法语法律词汇；每一支都保有命令之声。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root exists here; the family is Germanic through and through, so the Latin table stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此族无拉丁词根，纯出日耳曼语，拉丁同族表留空。

cloth bearing a sign; the summoning flag
to give up to another's ban, surrender
